titulo: Me finishing the last twenty pages
caption:
Me finishing the last twenty pages

The slump is usually in the middle. Endings tend to go faster than the stretch right before them makes you expect.

For the friend with a bookmark stuck at page 280.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, leaning toward a book on the right that opens and turns pages one after another. A bubble says ugh, the middle and its eyes narrow. Then the pages turn faster, a bubble says wait... and its eyes go wide. A last bubble says the end! and its eyes go happy with a pulse. The text stays: me finishing the last twenty pages. The last card: Choose friction.
